data.title: Home help application rejected by Muster BKK
data.summary: Your health insurer Muster BKK rejected your application for home help (Haushaltshilfe) during your hospital stay. You may object (Widerspruch) within one month of notification.
data.explanation: The insurer says home help under § 38 SGB V is only granted if a child under 12 lives in your household or if its rules (Satzung) provide more, and neither applies. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically or in person for the record at Muster BKK. The app shows until when you can do this. If you do nothing, the rejection becomes final. Consider asking a patient advisory service or a lawyer if you want to challenge it.
